CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Binary Ninja** — self-hosted media and networking containers for Unraid, maintained by [iFlip721](https://github.com/iFlip721).
This repository holds the Community Applications templates for those projects:
- **AirConnect** — AirPlay bridging to UPnP/Sonos and Chromecast devices, with a web UI for diagnostics. - **masqueradarr.aio** — self-hosted IPTV aggregator that normalizes multiple providers into one unified playlist and guide.
Support runs through each project's GitHub issue tracker or its Discord. Templates are kept in sync with the upstream images; open an issue here if a template itself is wrong.
CommunityApplications.DonateText: If these containers are useful to you, consider supporting the work.
